title: GitLab Runner authentication token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 19-character legacy body vs the 20-character Devise.friendly_token GitLab's token field generates and length: the base36 payload-length holder claims one more character than the base64url payload carries (checksum recomputed over the altered text, so only the length holder is wrong). Twin of "GitLab Runner authentication token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of gitlab-runner-authentication-token-ci-server-token: length: 19-character legacy body vs the 20-character Devise.friendly_token GitLab's token field generates. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
